mapper.insert: insert into ai_media_video_clip( video_id, task_id, transcript_id, segment_no, start_ms, end_ms, duration_ms, title, summary, core_viewpoint, clip_type, value_reason, tags_json, speakers_json, transcript_text ) values ( #{videoId}, #{taskId}, #{transcriptId}, #{segmentNo}, #{startMs}, #{endMs}, #{durationMs}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{coreViewpoint}, #{clipType}, #{valueReason}, #{tagsJson}, #{speakersJson}, #{transcriptText} )
mapper.select: select id, video_id, task_id, transcript_id, segment_no, start_ms, end_ms, duration_ms, title, summary, core_viewpoint, clip_type, value_reason, tags_json, speakers_json, transcript_text, object_key, file_size, created_at, updated_at from ai_media_video_clip where video_id = #{videoId} order by segment_no

select id, video_id, task_id, transcript_id, segment_no, start_ms, end_ms, duration_ms, title, summary, core_viewpoint, clip_type, value_reason, tags_json, speakers_json, transcript_text, object_key, file_size, created_at, updated_at from ai_media_video_clip where task_id = #{taskId} order by segment_no

select id, video_id, task_id, transcript_id, segment_no, start_ms, end_ms, duration_ms, title, summary, core_viewpoint, clip_type, value_reason, tags_json, speakers_json, transcript_text, object_key, file_size, created_at, updated_at from ai_media_video_clip where id = #{id}

select clip.id, clip.video_id, clip.task_id, clip.transcript_id, clip.segment_no, clip.start_ms, clip.end_ms, clip.duration_ms, clip.title, clip.summary, clip.core_viewpoint, clip.clip_type, clip.value_reason, clip.tags_json, clip.speakers_json, clip.transcript_text, clip.object_key, clip.file_size, clip.created_at, clip.updated_at, video.title as source_video_title, video.original_file_name as source_video_file_name from ai_media_video_clip clip inner join ai_media_video video on video.id = clip.video_id
(clip.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or clip.summary like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or clip.core_viewpoint like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or clip.tags_json like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or video.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and clip.clip_type = #{clipType}
and clip.speakers_json like concat('%', #{speaker}, '%')
order by clip.created_at desc, clip.id desc
